title: Immer in Bewegung / Natural flow

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Shape acceleration deliberately because a simple translation can feel either natural or mechanical.
strategic_value: A single bar moving with a varied pace can establish the feel of DB motion without extra decoration.
demonstration: One red vertical bar traverses a dark field horizontally and changes position through the loop.
practical_value: Compare the bar’s travel with the explicit easing specimens before selecting a timing curve.

content_islands.name: Traveling bar
content_islands.spec: Preserve the bar’s upright shape while changing its horizontal position.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying text specifies natural flow through easing and a lively rather than mechanical impression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The single bar isolates movement on a dark field.
